subject: Evaluation kickoff: Acme / Redwood - scheduling and agenda
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-28T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation kickoff - Acme / Redwood

Thanks again for the time today, Samir I really appreciate the thoughtful product questions. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock in the evaluation kickoff (technical deep-dive + trial plan):

Recap (from our discovery):
- Primary use-case: generate and summarize customer support transcripts to reduce TTR and surface escalation triggers.
- Success criteria: 15-20% reduction in average handling time (AHT) and >= 90% precision on escalation detection in our prompt set.
- Data/workflow notes: most traffic is short sessions (~150 tokens) with occasional long threads (up to 2k tokens); PII redaction required before sending to hosted endpoints.

Proposed evaluation kickoff (1h):
1) Introductions + timeline objectives (5m)
2) Trial plan walk-through (roles, data flows, duration, metrics) (20m)
3) Technical deep dive: model variants, latency/throughput targets, KV/prefix caching strategy, quantization options (20m)
4) Prompt set & evals: confirm initial prompt set, sampling, and scoring (10m)

Availability I have next week (all PT):
- Tue May 3, 10:00-11:00am
- Tue May 3, 2:00-3:00pm
- Wed May 4, 9:00-10:00am

Attachments: redwood-eval-plan-v1.pdf (trial plan + roles), acme-eval-questionnaire.docx (short questionnaire to help us scope data/connectors).

Would any of the times above work for you and who else from your side should join (tech lead, data/security)? I can add Connor (solutions engineering) and Neha (customer success) to lead the technical and success conversations.

Thanks - Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

Date: 2027-04-28T17:03:00-07:00

Thanks Marissa - great summary and the agenda looks right. We can do Tue May 3 10:00-11:00am PT. I'll bring our ML/infra lead (Elena Morales) and our product ops lead (Tom Hsu).

A couple quick clarifications so we can come prepared:
- For the prompt set, would you prefer we share sanitized transcripts ahead of time or walk through examples in the kickoff? We can do both but want to know what you need for an initial eval.
- On the PII redaction: we will handle redaction on our side, but we need confirmation that Redwood never stores raw transcripts and that we can enable customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) if needed for the private deployment later.

If you can send the calendar invite, add Connor and Neha as needed. Looking forward to it.

- Samir

Perfect - Tue May 3, 10:00-11:00am PT is booked. Calendar invite and Zoom link to follow (I'll include agenda and attachments).

Quick answers to Samir's clarifications:
- Prompt set: sanitized transcripts ahead of time are ideal - that lets Connor pre-run the eval harness and surface baseline numbers during the kickoff. If you prefer, share 5-10 sanitized examples first and we can discuss more samples live.
- Data handling/KMS: for the hosted evaluation we do not persist raw logs tied to customer IDs; we can also run the evaluation in a dedicated environment. We support customer-managed KMS for Private deployments; I'll have Connor bring the exact security details (SOC2 controls, retention, and KMS options) to the kickoff.

Connor and Neha - looping you in to lead the technical deep-dive and the trial plan respectively. Connor, can you confirm acceptance of May 3 10am PT and whether you need any specific artifacts (schema, example sanitized transcripts) before the call? Neha - I'll coordinate success metrics and the evaluation timeline with you after the kickoff.

Attached: redwood-eval-plan-v1.pdf, acme-eval-questionnaire.docx

Thanks - Marissa
